name: deck_equip_locked_curated
description: AP equip gate on a curated card (docs/enemies_ranking.md §4.8): a cost-2 POISON DAGGER (id 68) added to the collection cannot be decked while the pool is 1. Pressing A on its DECK row is rejected with NOT ENOUGH AP 2 on row 16, emits CARD_EQUIP_LOCKED (d1 = required AP), and emits no CARD_ADDED_TO_DECK. Fully-decked rows still clear under the MIN floor (deck_min_ui_message); only adding is gated. (The old cost-2 anchor was the fire sword; swords never ride now.)
